annotations.title: Before and after a proposed change

description:
Any change to one portfolio, measured before it is made: current and proposed holdings side
        by side on the same prices. In: two sets of holdings. Out: structure, share of the
        risk, falls in past crises, and what the change adds or removes; the figures are in
        the structured result. Typical questions: 'What happens if I sell half my QQQ and
        buy BND?'; 'Compare my portfolio now with this rebalanced version.'; 'I want to swap
        VXUS for VWO: before and after?'. Instead: for adding ONE new holding (how much of
        it is already owned, and a 'kept as cash' column) use check_before_you_buy. For one
        holding at every weight, sweep_holding. For separate unrelated portfolios,
        compare_portfolios. It does not recommend, predict or calculate tax.

base.description: Currency code every figure is expressed in: USD, EUR, GBP, CAD… Default USD.

outputSchema.description: The current and the proposed portfolio on the same history. The 'after' figures are counterfactual: that portfolio was not held.

_fence.description: What these figures are and are not: descriptive, no forecast, no advice. Repeat its sense when presenting the result.
